title: Qualification evidence and current boundary
summary: Ten suites pass on supplied ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196. Qualification covers first-class sphere component projection/aliasing/ownership, strict MCP JSON typing, ownership claim/release/re-claim semantics, JSONL replay, xAI 2025-11-25 routing, canonical and compatibility tool presentation, real HTTPS HttpResponse serialization, and live Gopher resolution.
invariants: Do not claim multi-process transactional journal safety for the JSONL backend.
Keep production public-network admission/certificate/firewall authority in HTTPS Server v0.4.4 or its successor.
Re-run all ten suites after project-semantic, protocol, route, or compatibility-presentation changes.
Ownership release must remain owner-only, append-only, idempotent when already unowned, and replay-safe.
Canonical and compatibility presentations must dispatch to identical Wire semantics.

provenance.claim: Grounded in sealed MCP Project Service v0.2-dev7 package.
